verdicts.decision_note: The client requests large-scale localization for the Android application, establishing implementation-relevant localization behavior and platform scope.
The missing Android strings were identified through source-code inspection, not an executed runtime test or observed operational failure.
The message identifies a material unresolved scope choice between full-app localization and store-listing-only localization.
The freelancer explicitly commits to the client-originated full-app localization scope, affecting which Android application content must be localized.
The explicit full-app commitment resolves the preceding material scope ambiguity and returns the Requirement to active execution.
The Android localization language set remains materially unresolved between all 77 Google Play languages and a shorter selected list.
The client selects all 77 Google Play languages, establishing the concrete Android localization coverage requirement without leaving stale conflicting attributes.
The client's selection resolves the language-set ambiguity and returns the Requirement to active execution.
This delivery-priority response does not change the already established 77-language Android behavior and adds no distinct implementation-relevant Requirement state.
